scope: Bounded original-image visual review; five successful vision_analyze inspections per ID, not a live interaction or source-mesh audit.

status_definition.pass: Candidate visual pass within the inspected views; not final user approval or release authorization.
status_definition.needs-decision: Required images reviewed, but an appearance/fidelity difference needs disposition; not automatically broken geometry.

limitations: Static desktop/mobile endpoint screenshots only; no fresh animation, collision, hinge-connectivity, clasp engagement or interaction test.
Hidden faces, underside, full cavity floor and fine attachment details are not certified by these camera angles.
Mobile screenshots are emulated, not physical-device verification; small details remain limited by rendered object size even in original PNGs.
Marketing images are promotional appearance references, not exact geometry or material specifications. Lighting and camera differ.
Released lid-mounted clasps and outside lid motifs turned away in open views are not counted as defects.
No Blender reopening, packaging/archive revalidation, art edits, lifecycle changes or new approval. Prior technical claims were not rerun.

findings.reason: Complete original-view review shows coherent closed and open presentation, with finish differences but no demonstrated structural or framing defect.
geometry_observations: Ivory body, green lid edging and feet, floral/diamond top ornament, corner caps and central brass clasp are present in closed views.
Both open views show a recessed cavity, green inner lid and rear hinge fittings; full silhouette including released clasp and feet remains in frame.
Desktop and mobile show no obvious missing wall, detached support or gross intersection. Dark rear-joint clearance is not proof of disconnection.
finish_and_fidelity_differences: Viewer lid field reads more beige/olive with darker green edging than the marketing image's softer teal-green treatment.
Viewer stone veining and green pattern are more repetitive, especially inside the lid; inlay and clasp are chunkier and less finely shaded.
visual_limitations: Hinge attachment and partly hidden cavity floor remain unverified; closed marketing does not validate the interior.
findings.next_decision: Candidate visual pass only; retain normal final-approval gate.

findings.reason: Complete original-view review retains the reference design identity and shows no definite geometry or mobile-layout failure.
geometry_observations: Brown frame, crimson inset panels, ivory paired scroll motifs and stitch borders, brass corner caps/clasp and short trimmed feet remain recognizable.
Open desktop/mobile views expose a coherent brown cavity and plain inner lid with rear hinge fittings; no framing clipping or clear panel failure.
Open-loop/segmented ornament also occurs in marketing; interrupted curves alone are not established broken applique. Exterior lid motifs face away when open.
finish_and_fidelity_differences: Viewer panels are stronger crimson than the muted rose-pink marketing panels.
Brown frame has less tactile leather-like texture; brass, bevels, scrollwork and felt rendering are flatter or more angular than the promotional treatment.
visual_limitations: Fine scroll joins and exact hinge mechanics are unresolved at screenshot scale; no cultural-fidelity certification.
findings.next_decision: Candidate visual pass with disclosed color/finish differences; no final approval inferred.

findings.reason: Original screenshots resolve the prior board-scale question: marketing has prominent tall black vertical body-corner accents, while visible model corners remain pale. This is a concrete appearance discrepancy requiring acceptance or correction direction, not demonstrated broken geometry.

fidelity_decisions.issue: Dark vertical corner trim present in marketing is not visibly reproduced on model body corners.
fidelity_decisions.classification: Reference/model appearance mismatch, not a confirmed mesh defect.
fidelity_decisions.required_decision: Accept the pale-corner model as an intentional variant or direct reference/model alignment; do not silently invent black geometry from promotional artwork.

geometry_observations: Pale body and block feet, turquoise inset/seam, elongated dune relief, brass lid-corner caps and front clasp are intact in closed views.
Open desktop/mobile views show pale recessed interiors and raised lids; entire model and controls fit without clipping.
No definite hole, missing wall, detached foot or gross lid penetration established.
finish_and_fidelity_differences: Model has more regular wavy horizontal striations and a flatter/more angular dune treatment than the softly grained marketing image.
Turquoise seam and simplified brass response are finish differences, not evidence of failed closure.
visual_limitations: The images establish visible corner-color difference, not whether the marketing strips are separate physical parts or whether hidden corners match.
findings.next_decision: Resolve corner-trim fidelity discrepancy; review itself is complete and no art modification is authorized.

findings.reason: All original views inspected; atoll/chart identity and hardware are retained with simplified finish, without an unequivocal structural or framing defect.
geometry_observations: Cream grid/weave body, alternating corner blocks, turquoise seam, atoll ring and raised stick-chart panel are visible in closed views.
Front clasp, separate round front fitting, side ring, corner caps and pale irregular feet remain present.
Both open views show a coherent woven cavity and inner lid, rear hinges and released clasp; no clipping or clear geometry break. Exterior atoll/chart turns away.
finish_and_fidelity_differences: Viewer weave is more uniform and less tactile, lagoon reads flatter, and brass is less reflective than marketing.
Feet are softer/lumpier and chart rods/markers less crisp at mobile scale; these are detail/readability limitations rather than proven broken components.
visual_limitations: Fine chart crossings/attachments and cultural chart accuracy are not certified; cavity floor and hidden support remain partly occluded.
findings.next_decision: Candidate visual pass with finish caveats; retain final-approval gate.

findings.reason: All original views inspected; landscape and hardware remain coherent with no definite structural or mobile-framing defect.
geometry_observations: Pale mountain ridge, turquoise river, green oval vegetation/insets and green seam preserve the closed reference identity.
Brass clasp, round fitting, side ring, lid corner caps and rounded pale supports remain visible.
Open views expose coherent pale interiors and hinge fittings; entire lid, released clasp and feet fit desktop and mobile. Terrain is on the turned-away outside face, not proven absent.
finish_and_fidelity_differences: Repeated diagonal/checkered or rippled body shading is more conspicuous than the smoother satin promotional finish.
Faceted terrain, ribbon-like river, bead-like green details and chunky feet are simplified relative to marketing; hardware has less refined reflections.
visual_limitations: Uneven-looking corner seams and partly hidden foot attachments do not establish a fault from these angles; no motion or terrain-clearance validation performed.
findings.next_decision: Candidate visual pass with finish caveats; no final approval inferred.
